asset.name: Sortable
asset.description: The reorder controller with collision strategies, animated displacement, keyboard operation, nested containers, optimistic persistence, and rollback when the write fails.

requires.reason: Pointer, keyboard, and announcement behavior are shared.
Displacement animates through the shared layout-difference primitive.
Reordering applies immediately and rolls back deterministically on failure.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.
